title: Event Management System

accessFiles.notes: Per-user FE copies. Shared BE on network/SharePoint. Repository folders are outside Access; store paths only.

alphaOutOfScope: Working MyVenue / Tips / Assignment import parsers

tables.name: tblVendorType
tables.purpose: Vendor classifications. Create and seed before tblVendor.

tables.name: tblEventType
tables.purpose: Event types. Create and seed before tblEvent.

fields.name: EventTypeShort
fields.description: Used in PDF file names: FB, MBB, WBB, CON, RNT, SPE, BB

tables.name: tblEventStatus
tables.purpose: Event lifecycle. Do not add statuses without a change request.
tables.notes: Allowed progression: OPEN -> FINANCE REVIEW -> CLOSED. No skipping. No reverse without admin override later.

tables.name: tblContractClass
tables.purpose: Sales rate buckets. NPO rolls FOOD+NA_BEV and BEER+LIQUOR. SUB uses four rates.

tables.name: tblAppSetting
tables.purpose: Keyed configuration. Settings form reads/writes this table. No hardcoded rates in VBA.

tables.name: tblAdjustmentType
tables.purpose: Statement add-on / deduction lines for Phase 2. Create empty-capable now and seed types.
tables.notes: Used by tblSettlementAdjustment in Phase 2. Seed now so statement lines stay stable.

tables.name: tblVendor
tables.purpose: Master vendor repository for NPOs and subcontractors.
tables.notes: Short code is the join key to legacy Excel. Do not change ARVC/LAG/SUG once seeded.

fields.name: VendorShortCode
fields.description: Payee key. Must match EVENT ASSIGNMENT NPO column and invoice suffix. Examples ARVC, LAG, SUG

fields.name: CheckPayableTo
fields.description: Prints on statement. Defaults to VendorName

fields.name: W9Path
fields.description: UNC/SharePoint path. Do not embed file.

tables.name: tblVendorContract
tables.purpose: Settlement rates. NPO rows use 10/10/8/8 and $200 min. SUB rows are vendor-specific.
tables.notes: If multiple contracts exist, settlement later uses the row where EffectiveDate<=EventDate AND (ExpirationDate is null OR ExpirationDate>=EventDate) AND Active=Yes.

fields.name: MinimumDonation
fields.description: NPO $200 in current process. Null/0 for SUB. Do not auto-apply in Phase 1.

fields.name: AllowExpenses
fields.description: SUB Yes (card fees, ice, COS). NPO No unless later required.

tables.name: tblLocation
tables.purpose: Permanent MyVenue location library. LocationCode is NOT unique (PIT 101 is two locations).

fields.name: MyVenueCode
fields.description: Numeric Code column from MyVenue location export

fields.name: LocationName
fields.description: Full MyVenue Name, e.g. FB 106 - RED RALLY NORTH EAST. Primary match target.

fields.name: Venue
fields.description: Football Stadium, The Pit, Baseball, Other

fields.name: Active
fields.description: No for ZZZ retired, warehouse, AA admin

tables.name: tblLocationAlias
tables.purpose: Protects imports from MyVenue naming drift. Matcher uses AliasName exact, case-insensitive.
tables.notes: See seed/location_alias_conflicts.csv. Mini Melts NW was coded FB 113 in NPO V4; official is FB 114.

fields.name: AliasName
fields.description: Must be unique across the table. Includes official LocationName.

tables.name: tblCategoryMap
tables.purpose: Maps MyVenue product codes to contract class and default NPO rate.
tables.notes: Add new product codes here when MSR exports change. Do not delete codes; deactivate.

tables.name: tblEvent
tables.purpose: One row per event. Status starts OPEN.
tables.notes: Composite business key is EventDate + EventName. Do not create a unique index until duplicate same-day events are ruled out (football vs concert same date possible).

fields.name: InternalEventName
fields.description: SUB workbook Internal Event Name/Notes, e.g. MEN'S BASKETBALL

tables.name: tblEventAssignment
tables.purpose: Who owns which location for an event, and at what allocation %. Core of NPO engine. Form can wait; table must exist.
tables.notes: Unique index: EventID + LocationID + VendorID. Control rule (Phase 2): allocations for EventID+LocationID should sum to 1 when the location is operated.

fields.name: Headcount
fields.description: Optional staffing count from assignment import

tables.name: tblImportBatch
tables.purpose: Tracks every import. Critical for auditing.
tables.notes: ImportType: SALES, ASSIGNMENTS, TIPS. Status: Completed, Partial, Failed.

tables.name: tblSalesImport
tables.purpose: Parsed MyVenue MSR category export (the 9/5/26 CSV shape).
tables.notes: LocationRaw is Copilot LocationName and is immutable. NetAmt is NPO settlement base.

fields.name: LocationRaw
fields.description: Exact MSR location string before alias match

tables.name: tblAssignmentImport
tables.purpose: Staging for staffing/ownership imports. Never the calculation source. Post matched rows to tblEventAssignment.
tables.notes: Copilot tblAssignmentImport. Calc uses posted tblEventAssignment only.

tables.name: tblTipsImport
tables.purpose: Gratuity import. NPO V4 TIPS DATA shape.

fields.name: AllocatedTips
fields.description: Copilot TipAmount. This is the payable tip.

tables.name: tblSettlementHeader
tables.purpose: One settlement per vendor per event. Create table now; no calc in Alpha.
tables.notes: Unique EventID+VendorID. Status: Draft, Reviewed, Approved, Paid. Invoice UNM-mmddyy-SHORTCODE

fields.name: SettlementType
fields.description: NPO or SUB copied at freeze

tables.name: tblSettlementDetail
tables.purpose: Per-location lines on a settlement.
tables.notes: One row per settlement+location. Four class nets/commissions; NPO rolls FOOD+NA_BEV and BEER+LIQUOR.

tables.name: tblSettlementAdjustment
tables.purpose: Cook fees, min donation, card fees, ice, shortages.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Store positive. Sign comes from AdjustmentType.DefaultIsDeduction.

tables.name: tblExceptionType
tables.purpose: Frozen exception codes for finance review.
tables.notes: Add types via seed, not by renaming this table.

fields.name: IsBlocking
fields.description: No for warnings such as NO_MSR_SALES

tables.name: tblExceptionLog
tables.purpose: Captures processing issues. Do not delete; resolve.
tables.notes: Copilot Chapter 11. Required or Finance will hate the system.

tables.name: tblDocumentRef
tables.purpose: Path registry. EMS stores references, never files.

fields.name: DocumentType
fields.description: W9, COI, CONTRACT, SETTLEMENT_PDF, IMPORT, OTHER

notes: Volume A follows Copilot v4.0 chapter map with live-file corrections. Create all JSON tables now. Phase B import/settlement/exception log stay empty except seeded lookups. Do not auto-apply the $200 NPO minimum.
